finding.headline: "The NIN-First Trap" (baby needs NIN before birth certificate)
finding.problem: "I went to register the birth and they said 'where's the NIN?' The baby doesn't HAVE a NIN yet. Nobody told me."
finding.person: Mum who discovers the NPC portal won't issue a birth certificate until the baby has a NIN — a two-step trap with a $50–70 fee she didn't budget.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (NIN-First Workflow) — critical in OS.". Verdict: PASSES.
